factual_errors.why_wrong: A USR-N540-class transparent RS-485-to-Ethernet converter has no firmware mode that makes it DH-485-compliant -- DH-485 requires token-passing network arbitration and a TX-EN open-collector control line that this class of hardware does not implement. Presenting a mode switch as a real possibility to check invites the technician to spend time hunting for a setting that cannot exist, rather than being told plainly that the fix is replacing the converter with a protocol-aware interface.
